description: Incident #852: a workflow with both push: and merge_group: triggers, where push does not exclude gh-readonly-queue/** — the branch push re-enters the merge queue and self-evicts the in-flight group. Hand-authored into rule3; the incident->rule precedent this pipeline systematizes.

WAS concurrency-gap backlog: per-commit/scheduled workflows fleet-wide lack a concurrency: block (runaway-run / self-DoS risk). Census surfaced ~890 shadow warnings spanning an estimated ~390-file gap across the fleet. Became rule1.

A public Cloudflare Worker (repo-private, but its route serves a public domain) shipped a hand-authored marketing landing containing internal references (private repo names, PR numbers, component/class names, an internal benchmark figure). Root gap: repo-private != content-private — GitHub-side controls (private repo, license audit) never see the leak surface a public Worker serves, and nothing gated the CONTENT before deploy. Scrubbed post-deploy; a CI content-safety guard has since been added to the originating repo.
